:::{#def-random-choice}
#### Choosing at random

To **choose an element at random** from a finite set $S$ is to run a
random experiment whose [sample space](#def-sample-space) is $S$
and whose [probability measure](#def-probability) gives every element
the same probability:

$$\Pr(A) \eqdef \frac{\abs{A}}{\abs{S}}, \quad A \subseteq S,$$

where $\abs{A}$ is the number of elements of $A$.
:::
